# Test Model Cleaning for Sharing

```{r, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(5678)
if(!require('pacman')) {
  install.packages('pacman')
}
pacman::p_load(data.table, ggplot2, tidyverse, stats)
remotes::install_github("BGDlab/gamlssTools@dev")
library(gamlssTools)

base <- "/mnt/isilon/bgdlab_processing/Margaret/sex_mod_braincharts"
```

Get 50 random models and corresponding fit csvs

```{r}
mod_paths <- Sys.glob(file.path(base, "cv_sample_?_test/*/model_objs/*full_mod.rds"))
mod_paths <- mod_paths[!str_detect(mod_paths, "weight")] %>% sample(size = 10) #ignore weighted, grab 50


# make df, get info to map back to df
mod_df <- tibble(mod_path = mod_paths) %>%
  mutate(
    mod_dir   = basename(dirname(dirname(mod_path))),
    cv_sample = str_extract(mod_path, "(?<=cv_sample_)[A-Za-z]+(?=_test)"),
    total     = str_extract(mod_dir, "(?<=total)(TRUE|FALSE)"),
    log_age   = str_extract(mod_dir, "(?<=logAge)(TRUE|FALSE)"),
    age2plus  = str_detect(mod_dir, "age2plus"),
    pheno     = str_remove(basename(mod_path), "_.*$")     # phenos contain no "_"
  )

#find csv function
find_csv <- function(cv_sample, pheno, total, log_age, age2plus) {
  if (age2plus) {
    hits <- file.path(base, "data", paste0("cv_sample_", cv_sample, "_age2plus"),
                      paste0(pheno, "_total", total, "_test_df.csv"))
    hits <- hits[file.exists(hits)]
  } else {
    hits <- Sys.glob(file.path(base, "data", paste0("cv_sample_", cv_sample, "_dfs"),
                               paste0(pheno, "_total", total, "*logAge", log_age, ".csv")))
  }
  if (length(hits) == 1) hits else NA_character_
}

mod_df <- mod_df %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(csv_path = find_csv(cv_sample, pheno, total, log_age, age2plus)) %>%
  ungroup()

#load
load_pair <- function(row) {
  mod <- readRDS(row$mod_path)
  df  <- fread(row$csv_path, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, na.strings = "")
  mod$call$data   <- "df"          # needed for predict/gamlssTools
  mod$call$family <- mod$family[[1]]
  list(model = mod, df = df, meta = row)
}
sample_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(mod_df)), function(i) load_pair(mod_df[i, ]))
names(sample_list) <- with(mod_df, paste(cv_sample, pheno, paste0("total", total),
                                            ifelse(age2plus, "age2plus", ""), sep = "_"))
```

sanitize
```{r}
sample_list <- lapply(sample_list, function(x) {
  x$clean <- sanitize_gamlss(x$model, grid_n=5000)
  x
})
```

check results
```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
comp_list <- lapply(sample_list, function(x) {
  compare_scores(x$model, x$clean, data=x$df, fit_data1=x$df)
})
```

plot
```{r}
z_df <- as.data.frame(t(vapply(comp_list, `[[`, numeric(2), "z_diffs"))) %>%
  rename(max_z = max, mean_z = mean) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("model") %>%
  mutate(n_tied = vapply(comp_list, function(x) as.integer(x$n_tied), integer(1))) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(model, "_",
                       names = c("cv_sample", "pheno", "total", "age2plus"),
                       cols_remove = FALSE, too_few = "align_start") %>%
  mutate(total    = str_remove(total, "total"),
         age2plus = age2plus == "age2plus")

z_df %>%
  mutate(pheno = forcats::fct_reorder(pheno, max_z)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(max_z, mean_z), names_to = "stat", values_to = "diff") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pheno, y = diff, color = stat, shape = total)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(y = "|difference| (log scale)", x = NULL)

#greatest z-score abs diff phenos
max(z_df$max_z)

#greatest average z-zcore abs diff across phenos
max(z_df$mean_z)

range(z_df$n_tied)
```

plot centile line overlay

```{r}
lapply(sample_list, function(x){
  sim_list <- sim_grid(x$df, "logAge_days", "sexMale", special_term = "sexMale_x_logAge = sexMale * logAge_days")
  plt <- compare_centile_fans(x$model,
                              x$clean,
                              df=x$df,
                              x_var="logAge_days",
                              facet_var="sexMale",
                              sim_grid_list=sim_list,
                              desiredCentiles = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.5, 0.95, 0.99),
                              x_axis="log_lifespan_fetal") +
    labs(subtitle=paste("Sample", x$meta$cv_sample, ", total-size-corrected =", x$meta$total, ", ages 2+ only =", x$meta$age2plus))
  print(plt)
})

```
